subject.title: refactor: centralize bounded file reads in fs-safe

question: Should this refactor remain draft until the published fs-safe 0.4.2 artifact and all repository dependency-transition artifacts are committed and revalidated?
rationale: The current patch intentionally relies on an unpublished dependency API, so a maintainer must decide when the external release is ready to become part of OpenClaw’s supported dependency contract.

options.title: Wait for the published dependency
options.body: Keep the PR draft, then pin the released artifact, regenerate required dependency artifacts, and rerun validation against that exact package.

options.title: Defer the refactor
options.body: Close or pause this draft if the fs-safe release or ownership path is not ready, retaining the existing local descriptor reader until a complete dependency transition is available.

recommendation.title: Wait for the published dependency
recommendation.body: Keep the PR draft, then pin the released artifact, regenerate required dependency artifacts, and rerun validation against that exact package.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR body identifies this contributor as coordinating the upstream fs-safe release and the follow-on dependency commit.
